headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a 3-0 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Keider Montero earning the win. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with notable moves including San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. Additionally, the Giants' Trevor McDonald was transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. The Boston Red Sox placed Garrett Whitlock on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, with a right elbow inflammation.

Several trades and roster movements took place, with the Baltimore Orioles acquiring center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade. The deal is part of the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade, with a player to be named later still to be determined.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 3-0 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Keider Montero earning the win. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Chicago White Sox in a thrilling 9-8 victory. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Marlins 13-1 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 13-1 victory over the Miami Marlins, behind a standout performance from their offense and pitching staff. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' charge with 2 home runs and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Take Down Yankees in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a narrow win over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after 6.0 innings of scoreless baseball. Weston Wilson led the Mariners' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Matt Chapman Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. He was initially placed on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Rivas Traded to Orioles**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade. The deal is part of the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade, with a player to be named later still to be determined.
